tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub 'byung ba'i khungs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpal ldan rgyud mdzad pa dang sdud pa po// slar bsdu rgyas 'grel mdzad dang 'chad nyan pa// mos klung rnam mang ye shes dgung gi zlar// dngos gcig 'jam mgon bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// dri med 'od kyi 'dzam bu'i 'bras yid 'ong*// rba rlabs 'phreng brdar gser gzan tshe ring bya// dngos grub stong khun srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i// gnam gyi she mong gnyis pa nga min su// dang por yang dag bsten zhes bya ba la sogs pa dam pa dang*/ nga rgyal dang ldan zhes bya ba la sogs pa dam pa ma yin pa mtshon par byed pa'i tshogs bla ma legs par brtags nas dam pa bsten par bya'o// bla mas kyang*/ zab cing zhes sogs kyi snod mchog 'bring tha ma legs par shes pas skal ba bzhin bkri bar bya ba yin pas/ de'i tshul ni/ slob dpon dus zhabs pa dam pa'i snang ba dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor yang ni rnam pa gnyis// lhag gnas dang ni mchod pa'o// lhag gnas la yang rnam gnyis te// rang don dang ni gzhan don no// mchod pa la yang rnam gnyis te// bdag sgrub dang ni gzhan sgrub bo// sngon 'gro dngos dang rjes dang ni// yan lag la sogs thun mong ngo*// zhes gsungs pas/ dang po lhag gnas kyi yan lag ni/ bsnyen pa song pa'i spyan sngar slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ skye ba mang po'i sdig pa ni// bsags pa rnam par 'jig byed pa// sdom pa so sor gzung bar bgyi// dpa' bo dus kyi 'khor lo mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab/ bla mas kyang so shing sbyin pa dang bsrung ba byas/ rung ba'i gza' skar ldan pa nag pa'i tshes bcu la las dang rjes su mthun pa'i sa bcags la| snang ba la tshig gam rin gyis dang*/ mi snang ba la slong ba'i phyir snga dro sa'i cha der phyin nas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rdo rje shugs su bskyed nas srung 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms te/ de nas de'i zhing skyong la oṃ āḥhūm̐ che ge mo zhes nas dzaḥhūm̐ḥbar gyis bos yon chab la sogs pas mchod/

gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po gzhan yang rung*// dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni// bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol// de nas gtor ma i daṃ ba liṃ man lan gsum brjod gnang ba byin nas gshegs/ de nas sa'i ro bsal zhing gter bcug stegs bu khru bzhi lhag pa'i khyon dbus mtho mtha' gzhol ba ba lang gi lci ba'am dri bzang pos byugs pa bya/ spos chus brlan pa'i lag pa sa gzhi la reg ste nye snying bzla zhing rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam mo// de nas dgongs mo rnal 'byor gyi yo byad dang gtor ma gsum dang mchod pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa bshams nas| slob dpon he ru ka'i chas su zhugs pas yan lag bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs tshar gyis bsgoms te gtor ma byin nas gtor mgron gshegs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su dri'i byug pa byas te me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la laṃ dang*/ mdun gyi gzhi pad zlar laṃ las 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las sa'i lha mo ser mo zhes nas spyan ma bzhin dang na bza' ser po dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes kyi sa'i lha mo spyan drangs/ oṃ lāṃ aḥhuṃ ba sun+dha ri sarba bud+dha dza na ni sarba satwa ba kā ri ṇi/ badz+ra satwa ādzña pa la ti shīghāṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bsres/ i daṃ gan+dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ dhu paṃ dī paṃ nai be d+yaṃ pha lāk+ṣāṃ tā da ngā mi ta pa tā me pa grih+na grih+na/ rgyal bas lha yi bdag po dang bcas bdud ni bcom pa dag la lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur// de phyir khyod ni mchod par bya zhing lha mchog gis btud bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon no// zhes mchod cing bstod nas rdo rje dril bu gzung ste/ ji ltar rgyal bas byang chub slad du bdud kyi sde ni stobs ldan dag kyang rab tu bcom gyur pa/

de bzhin bdag gis kyang ni slob ma rnams la dbang bskur slad du bdud rnams nyams bdag tu bya// khyed dbang du gyur pas so// lan gsum brjod/ maṇ+ḍal lār+thaṃ ma ma s+thi naṃ nga ngā/ sarba satwā nāṃ shīn+taṃ puṣ+ṭa kri twā shu bha tsit+tan i daṃ s+thā naṃ t+yaka twā a pa ra s+tha naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mnyes nas/ sa'i gnas la dag pa dag ni ji ltar 'dod pa mdzod ces gnang nas de nyid du thim/ de nas sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad la badz+ra gan+dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ dhū paṃ dī paṃ ni bad+ya pha lā k+ṣa taṃ da dā mi/ mchod pa phul/ gang dag phyogs rnams kun nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyes pa rnam bral btsun mo dang bcas pa| /de dag rnams kyi mchog gi snying rjes dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur slad du bdag la bskyang du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas phyogs bzhir don yod grub pa sogs kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma bzhi'am med na bsams pas kyang rung ste/ mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bsdus nas rdo rje shugs kyi rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐/ mig gnyis m dang ṭ las nyi zla mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me lta bu'i nga rgyal gzung ste oṃ āḥsogs sreg sngags kyis lus las me 'bar sogs bgegs sreg sgrub thabs bzhin/

seng ldeng gi phur pa sor bcu gnyis spoms su sor bzhi pa bcu/ tsan dan dmar pos byugs shing tshon skud lnga dang mgor me tog yungs kar bcings pa las kyi rdo rjes phyogs bcur gdab cing*/ de nas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa la sogs pa gzhan rnams rdo rje lcags kyus bkug cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas/ ha ya ra wa la lā wā rā lā hā las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur pa khro bo'i rgyal po lde ba'i 'og rtse mo gcig pa phyogs bcur gdug pa'i mgo bor bying ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ badz+ra kī la kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa te ṣe ḍa mu kha ṣe ṭa bhu dza ṣa ṭa tsa ra ṇa sarba bigh+ni bi nā ya kā di duṣ+ṭā naṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā nā ni kī la ya kī la ya kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ de dag rdo rje tho bas brdungs/ oṃ l+līḥbadz+ra muṅga ra mā rā di nāṃ/ si ra si/ kaṇ+ṭhe/ hṛ da ye/ nā bhau/ gu h+ye/ an+te/ badz+ra kī la kānā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya| k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣīṃ k+ṣ+rīṃ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣ+li k+ṣl̥̄ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar phug nas sa gzhi dang sbrags te g.yo ba med par gyur/ nga ni rang nyid rdo rje can// nga ni rdo rje shugs nyid do| /nga ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che// nga ni stobs chen rdo rje can// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal po nga*// nga ni phyag na rdo rje brtan// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje shugs// srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje 'bar ba'i sku yis ni// lus gsum las skyes 'gas par bya// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// rnam par brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// zhes lan gsum gyis bgegs la bka' bsgos te/ rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'i phyag rgyas rkang mthil du reg nas rdo rje'i stabs kyis dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi sa la bcag cing g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang dang mnyam pa'i stabs kyis kyang ngo*// shar du yaṃ yāḥrkang pa'i mthil la bkod cing ral gri'i phyag rgyas reg nas zlum po/

lhor raṃ rāḥbakod nas rin po che'i phyag rgyas reg cing rol ba/ nub tu laṃ lāḥbakod cing 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas reg nas rdo rje'i gdan nam sa ga /byang du waṃ wāḥbakod nas pad+ma'i phyag rgyas reg nas pad+ma'i gdan nam taṇ+ḍa ba ste gar gyi stabs kyis bcag par bya'o// phur pa la de nas bsrung 'khor bzhin khro bcu spros/ mchod bstod bya ba lhag gnas sngon 'gro 'o// de nas dri la sogs pas sa gzhi mchod/ oṃ āḥlāṃ huṃ badz+ra mi tiṣ+ṭha ma tsa la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ rdo'i sa gzhi spyan drangs pa de nyid du 'khod pa la sngar bzhin mchod/ sa lhag gnas so// der dri'i byug pa dkyil 'khor gyi lhag gnas gar 'bab ma 'khrul ba tshom bus bskor mtha' mchod pas bstar/ rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar bya/ tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang*/ zhes nas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid can tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la/ ye shes 'khor lo'i shar gyi 'dab mar nag mo 'bar ma zhes nas/ klu dang rab gtum ma rnams 'khod par gyur/ yab yum gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ spyi bor hā/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs rkang pa brgyad pa zhes nas bstod pa'i bar bya/ gtor ma dang tshogs kyi mchod pas kyang mnyes par bya/ cho ga'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas te/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can// sna tshogs yum gyis mgul nas 'khyud// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ba// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni bshad pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum gsol ba gdab lha lhag gnas so// slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bum pa la rgyu gser dngul med nas las byas pa nag po dang*/

rtsa ba med pa dkar po byas pa tshad rgyar sor bcu drug dpangs su nyi shu| mgrin par sor drug /kha la sor brgyad byas pa'i sum gnyis mtha' dang gcig bu ga mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba/ grangs bcu'am drug gam lnga dung chos dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba'i bum pa la sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum/ rnam rgyal la gri gug /phyogs bzhi la pad nyi'i steng du shar la ral gri nag po/ lhor rin po che dmar po/ nub tu 'khor lo ser po/ byang du pad+ma dkar po/ mtshams bzhi la mer ral gri/ bden bral la pad ma/ rlung du 'khor lo ser po/ dbang ldan du ut+pal dkar po/ yal 'dab dang bcas pa'i shing gis kha brgyan/ phyogs mdog gi gos dang skud pa dkar po lngas mgul dkris/ yi ge drug pa bzla zhing gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs te sman lnga dri lnga 'bru lnga rin po che lnga lcags lnga bdud rtsi lnga btab pa'i dang chus sum gnyis bkang*/ bum rdzas rnams so sor ma nor bar gzhug /rnam rgyal chen po dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas pad+ma la dbus dang phyogs mtshams| rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po dung chos chus gang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje me tog gi 'phreng ba btags pa gzhag /de nas shūn+ya tās bsangs/ haṃ las gzhal yas khang*| paṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho/ hrī las de'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la hūm̐ las skad cig gis lha rnams te dbus dang phyogs so so'i bum par bskyed/ rnam rgyal chen por thams cad rdzogs par bsgom/ mtshan ma yang lhar/ ye shes pa dgug /byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod byas me tog gi 'phreng ba ldan pa'i rdo rje gzung nas bum pa la reg la gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla/ yi ge drug pa bzlas pa'i me tog dor bas lha rnams chags pa chen pos zhu ba byang chub kyi sems kyi gzugs su ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/

bum pa oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hṛṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūṃ h+laṃ h+līṃ badz+ra pad+mā mṛ ta gha ṭa su bishud+dha dhārma dhā tu swa bhā ba sarba dharmā na su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dri la sogs pa phul bum pa gos kyis bkab/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bsrung dben par bsdu/ bum pa lhag gnas so// dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'i gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i thig skud sum sgril du byas pa sboms su mthe bo'i nas kyi tshad rang khru brgyad pa la a las zla ba sogs nas/ oṃ āṃ īṃ rīṃ ūṃ līṃ badz+ra sū tra sarba dharme ka swa bhā wa sarba dharmā na e ka ā kā ra swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dri sogs kyis mchod de byang du gzhag /rdul tshon rin po che'am 'bru'am sa tshon sde lnga/ oṃ aṃ iṃ riṃ uṃ liṃ su bi shud+dha pañtsa skan+dha swa bhā wa pañtsa skan+dhā na su bi shud+dha dharmā na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sngar bzhin mchod nas nub tu gzhag /rdo rje tshad ldan/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhā badz+raṃ sarba sa twa ka ru ṇā da ma ka sarba dharma ka su kha swā bhā wa sarba dharma na badz+ra su kha swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swā hā| sngar bzhin mchod de lhor gzhag /dril bu tshad ldan oṃ ho badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe sarba dharme ka pra dzñā dhā ni swa bhā wa sarbā kā re sarba dharma pra bo dha ni sarba dharmā na niḥswa bhā wa na pra bo dhā ya pra bo dhā ya swāhā| mchod nas byang du 'god /sbyin sreg gi lhag gnas dang*/ sgrub thabs bzhin gtor ma lhag gnas bya'o// de dag rang don gyi lhag gnas so// slob ma gcig gam mang po yang rung ste khrus byas gos gtsang ma gyon maṇ+ḍal phul la pus mo sa la btsugs te me tog snyim par gzung nas 'khod pas/ de ring nyid nas mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phros dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so// zhes gsol ba gdab/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs spyi mthun dang*/ khyad par/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos gzung bar bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rims la sdom pa dag ni bskyang bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba skyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// zhes smon lam btab pas sdom pa gzung*/ de nas brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ 'tshe dang mi 'tshe gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid// 'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di dag go /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba lha dang mi yi bla ma de yis mtshan gyi rab sbyin bya// sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' ni srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya// cho lo kha na ma thor bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos// ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o// grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la 'khu ba yang*// dbang po rnams ni chags pa dag dang de ltar srid pa'i bdag po dag gi brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa// brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po// sna tshogs gtso bo'i gsung ji bzhin// bdag gis rtag tu bskyang bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis khas blang*/ dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i ltung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur// de yi bka' la 'gongs pas gzhan du 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spun la khros pa gsum pa'o// byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur te byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur// drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ri bo dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba byin pas so// phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dad gang*// rgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba bde ba ster la rtog pa phyogs dang drag po'o// dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma dam tshig thob pa gtong pa las kyang gzhan// bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje theg par gnas pa rnams la'o// zhes bsgrag

/de nas slob ma gtso bo yab yum du bskyed nas/ slob ma'i dpral bar ū/ snying kar i/ gtsug tor du aḥlte bar l̥̄/ mgrin par ṝ/ gsang bar āḥ zla ba sogs kyi gdan la| de nas snying kar sgra gcan/ mgrin par nyi ma/ dpral bar zla ba hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ brjod cing gnas der dri'i chu dang bcas pa'i rdo rjes reg /nyer mchod lngas mchod/ de nas 'o ma can gyi shing la byas pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa drang po dri zhim po'i chus bkrus me tog gi 'phreng ba bcings dri sogs kyis mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhuṃ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥbadz+ra dan+ta kā ṣ+ṭha tsa tu ra bi so k+ṣa mu kha bi shud+dha swabhā waṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na mu kha dan+tā di ma laṃ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya swa hā/ zhes pas byin nas tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi khar oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun bzlas te phyogs kyi cha gang du lhung ba de'i las rab 'byams 'grub par brda sprad/ de nas dri zhim po'i chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa khyor ba gsum oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha dharma sarba pā pā ni tsā s+ya shodha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas blud lhag ma rgyab tu dor/ de nas slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i skud pa dmar po gsum sgril hūm̐ las byung ba de dang yi ge drug pa lan bdun bzlas mdud pa gsum byas pa dpung par bcings/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbā na swā hā/ bsrung*/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying kar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gtsug tor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣa zhes pas go bskon/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥbadz+ra satwa mahā su kha badz+ra kā la tsakra shi ṣ+ya s+ya a bhi mu kha bhai ba/ san+tu ṣ+ṭo bha ba/ ba ra do bha ba/ kā ya wa ka tsit+ta dhiṣ+ṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdo rje sems dpa' bskul bas sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs nas mchog stsol bar bsam/ de nas ku sha rtse mo ma nyams pa bsangs te hūm̐ las skyes pa hūm̐ dang yig drug bzlas pa stan gyi don du/

dhīḥlas byung ba de dang yig drug bzlas pa/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha baṃ zhes pas sngas kyi don du byin/ mngal du mngal na gnas pa'i sdug bsngal btsa' ba'i dus dang byis pa'i dngos po la yang sdug bsngal te// gzhon nu dang ni lang tsho dag la bud med nor dang 'byor nyams nyon mongs sdug bsngal chen po gang*// rgan po nyid la 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yang 'gro ba drug tu 'jig ster ngu 'bod la sogs te// sgyu mas rmongs par byas pa'i mtha' dag 'gro ba 'di ni sdug bsngal dag la sdug bsngal 'dzin par byed// 'khor ba mi nyid du ni 'gyur ba dag kyang 'ga' zhig tu ste chos kyi blo ni re 'ga' na// de bas sangs rgyas la ni rjes chags dge ba'i dbang gis 'gyur zhing dang ba'i theg par rab tu 'jug /de bas dpal ldan rdo rje'i theg pa bsgom pa la ni blo gros ma lus brgya lam dag na 'jug /de la sangs rgyas nyid 'dod mchog gi bde ba'i go 'phang dag la 'jug pa e ma shin tu dka'// zhes pas chos bshad/ slob ma la rmi lam rtog la ci rmi ba de nga la shod cig ces brjod/ de ni gzhan don gyi lhag gnas so// tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor snying kar bsdu/ lho phyogs su mtshan ma shes pa'i don du/ oṃ hau badz+ra ka ma la dal gar+bhe sha y+ye badz+ra su kha mahā ni drāṃ ka ro mi ya thā/ ta thā ga ten kri tā haḥhaḥswāhā/ zhes pas mtshan ma lta ba'i ched du mal stan lhag par gnas par bya'o// bum pa rnams gnas dben sar gzhag /mtshan ma brtags la ngan na bzlog pa'i cho ga bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i gtor ma dang*/ khro bo'i dbang po'i bsnyen pa bzhin bzlas pa bya'o// de ni lhag gnas kyi rjes so/ nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// de nas gnas te bar brgyan pa'i yan lag thig rnams bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du skad cig gis gsal ba'i rang gi snying gar ā li las zla ba/ kā li las nyi ma| de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ de dag yongs su gyur pa las dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab dang bcas pa'i thugs kar zla nyi kha sbyar ba'i dbus su āṃ īṃ ṝṃ ūṃ līṃ rang rang las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can spros pas yum lnga spyan drangs pa thig skud dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa thig skud kyi rnam par gyur/

rdo rje'i thig skud yang dag par mchod/ de las dang mthun pa'i tshul gyis spangs nas| slob dpon nub nas shar du phyogs pa'i khu tshur g.yon pa dang*/ slob ma shar nas nub tu bltas pa'i khu tshur g.yas pas thig skud gzung nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ka bhū tāḥsarba dharmā o kā kā ra ṇa badz+ra satwa haṃ bhū mi sū tra yā mi hūm̐ āḥphaṭ/ de nas rdo rje'i thig 'debs pa'i sngags kyis 'debs par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra sū trai kā kā ra swa rū pa ṇa dzaḥdzaḥsarba dharmā na sū tra ya oṃ āḥhuṃ ho haṃk+ṣaḥphaṭ/ bla ma g.yon skyil krung phyed pa g.yas mthil sa la gzhag pa dang*/ slob ma de bzlog pas so// de nas lho byang*/ de nas mtshams nas rim pa bzhin gdab cing*| slob dpon me rlung nas tshur dang*/ slob ma de nas phar mi 'da' yongs 'joms 'gongs pa dang thig skud 'chad pa la sogs pa mtshan ma ngan pa byung na sngar bzhin bzlog pa yang bya'o| /mnyam pa gru bzhi bcu drug cha// kun la'o cha rer sor phyed skur// bcu gnyis gsung drug thugs kyi gsum// dang po phyed bzhi gnyis pa bzhir// lnga pa dbus dor drug phyed phyi| /sgo dpangs cha phran drug tu bya// sgo gsum la ni rta babs so// drug dang phyed lnga phyed bzhi gnyis// yang*/ gnyis su 'og nas rim bzhir bya// snam bu myos bsrung re 'og ma| /sor phyed pa re gnyis re phyed// rgyar ni nyer bzhi bcu drug dang*// bco brgyad bcu nyis bco lnga brgyad// bar ma gru bzhi gsum par ka /gcig dang chas smin byed mthar brgyan// har mi'i rgyar brgyad bum pa gnyis// ltar drug zlum gcig lnga bdun bzhi// bdun pa'i phyi nang re ka bzhi// rta babs rtse nas cha phran ni// gsum drug drug drug gsum drug bskor thig ro rnams dbyi/ thig tshad de ye shes pa gshegs/ de nas tshon byin brlab thig 'dra ba la/ aṃ iṃ ṛṃ uṃ liṃ rang rang las sangs rgyas lnga rdul tshon gyi rnam par gyur ces 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo// 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams rab sgrol byed// rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes brjod cing dbang ldan nas brtsams te bri/

rdo rje 'phreng ba nang ma'i sa gzhi ljang khu'am sngon po/ shar nag /lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser po/ pad+ma ljang khu/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nang ma nag po/ phyi ma ljang*/ ka ba gnyis po rigs kyi mtshan mas brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i phyi zur bzhi'i dbang ldan du dung dkar/ lhor gaṇ+ḍī dmar po/ mer nor bu nag po/ rlung dpag bsam ser po/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i bar gyi bum pa dkar po kha rgyan pad gdan dang bcas pa/ gshegs pa sems dpa'/ khro bo'i gdan pad dkar nyi ma dmar po/ gzhan rnams pad dkar dang*/ zla dmar/ lha'i snam bu dang 'dod snam gnyis dkar po/ kha khyer dmar po/ mun pa nag po| ba ku lī gzhi ma sngon po la de dag dkar po/ mda' yab dkar po/ rta babs kyi ka ba ser po/ rta babs sna tshogs mdog /phyi zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsung la pad 'dab brgyad| sku la bzhi brgyad bcu drug pa/ snam bu'i steng gi pad+ma rnams phyogs mdog /lha'i mtshan ma sa bon/ mtshams su dkar po/ sku'i rta babs kyi 'og tu 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs gdan/ phyi'i khor yug gis ser po la dbang ldan du zla nya/ bden bral du nyi ma/ chu dkar/ me dmar/ rlung nag /me rlung gi mtshams su dur khrod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad phyogs dmar/ mtshams dmar sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad/ nam mkha' ljang khu g.yas g.yon du cha phran gsum dor ba'i dbus ma la rdo rje 'phreng ba/ de'i phyir 'od zer 'phreng ba kha dog lnga pa/ sku'i mda' yab dang sa'i khor yug gi bar la bum sogs mchod rdzas rta babs kyi ka rgyan 'og ma glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge /steng ma gnyis sha la bhañdzi ka te gnod sbyin mo/ sku'i rta babs kyi lha gnas dbu ma'i shar du 'khor lo/ g.yas g.yon ri dwags/ lhor bum pa/ g.yas g.yon dung pad/ byang du rnga bo che/ g.yas g.yon dbyug pa dang tho ba byang du dpag bsam gyi shing*/ g.yas g.yon du mi 'am ci pho mo rta babs kyi snam bu las 'phyar ba'i dril bu dang me long ba dan rnams dkar po/

rdul tshon rlung gis bda' ba sogs byung na mtshan ma ngan pas/ bzlog pa'i cho ga sngar bzhin bya/ rdul tshon lhag ma'i ye shes gsheg go /de dag ni mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yan lag go /slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pa bzhi sgor/ de bzhin bum 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi mtshams bzhir/ las thams cad la mkhas pa zhig las kyi rdo rje can du bya/ gal te rang gis dbang bskur ba med na de dag spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa gzung nas slob ma lhag gnas tsam bya/ las kyi rdo rje med na slob dpon rang gis sbyin sreg sogs bsgrub dgos so// de nas bum pa phyogs su bzhi/ rgyal ba shar gyi shar du/ drug yod na rnam rgyal nub kyi nub tu/ bcu yod na mtshams su bzhi/ bcu gcig pa ni rnam rgyal chen po dung chos yin pas rgyal ba'i steng du gzhag /zur bzhir bsang bum| phyogs mtshams mdo bzhi bklag pa/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas bkod pa'i khyad par thams cad kyis brgyan par bya'o// sngon du 'gro ba'o// de nas slob dpon shar du 'dug pas srung 'khor tshogs bsag nas gzung thig le'i rnal 'byor bar gyi bdag bskyed bsgom ste/ rdul tshon bsangs la oṃ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gi nas 'og nas rim pa bzhin 'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a aḥ.aṃ ā/ ha hā/ haṃ haḥnas/ k+ṣaṃ haṃ/ haṃ ka /rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes nas/ ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi 'dab mar nag mo 'bar ma zhes pa nas klu dang rab gtum ma rnams 'khod par gyur/ zhes bsgoms nas/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas skyes pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi thugs gsung sku'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dzaḥdagug /hūm̐ gis de dag la gzhug /baṃ gyis bcings/

hoḥyig gis mnyes par byas pas ro mnyam du gyur cing go bskon/ sku gsung thugs byin brlab/ dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// sde nas rgyal ba'i bum pa'i mdun du tsan dan sogs dri bzang gi dkyil 'khor zlum po khru gang mthe bong dang mid med dag gis byas pa der/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥtrai dhā tu ka shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wāṃ ra twaṃ bha ga bān me bang do bhawa shiṣ+ya nāṃ tsa/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i mchod yon/ oṃ pra wa ra saṃt+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon phul de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ gis zhal bsil/ āñtsa mā naṃ zhabs bsil/ po k+ṣa tsaṃ bsang gtor/ de nas snying ga nas lha mo bcu gnyis spros la mchod/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs nor bu'i gzi// gser dngul mi zad rin chen phung po'i gter// rnam bkra'i gos zung yid sim gyi sang ?spos// mar me'i mtshar dang dril sgra me long dang*// bla bre mchog dang 'bras bu ba dan dang*// gar dang rol mo'i mchod pa re re yang*// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar ma lus pa'i// sprin gyi phung po ma chags pas mchod par bgyi/ rin po che sna bdun la sogs pas kyang mchod| bdud rtsi na maḥmachod pa'i sngags kyis 'bul/ lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas kyang mchod/ gang la thog mtha' dbus sogs kyis bstod/ bum pa bskyed chog lhag gnas bzhin la mdun bskyed dang lhan du byas/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams nyi shu rtsa re/ yig brgya bzla/ de nas dkyil 'khor las kyi rdo rje'am grogs la bsrung du bcug nas phyi rol du song nas khro bo sogs la gtor ma byin/ oṃ badz+ra ut+gaha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya/ hūm̐/ shar sgo dbye/ rdo rje shugs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs la rkang pa brgyad pa zlos shing rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol bas las kyi slob ma dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor la bskor lan gsum bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor la bltas te/

oṃ par masu khā sha la su la lī ta bi lā si na mi/ tai na mā mi bha ga wan+ti dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi hīḥpra tīts+tsha ku su ma añdza liṃ nā tha hoḥ zhes pas gtso bo la me tog gi 'phreng ba phul/ oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha yā mi zhes brjod cing gar byas nas me tog gi 'phreng ba blangs tai mgo la gzhag /dkyil 'khor la phyag byas te sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig ces gsol ba gdab bo| /de nas slob dpon 'chad/ 'gyur bzhin bdag 'jug bya'o// de ni bdag sgrub pa'o// de nas yol ba'i phyir slob ma khrus byas/ sta gon bzhin gsol btab brtul zhugs lnga byin nas| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṃ kā ra ba ltar pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas smad g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ zhes pas stod g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ ces pas thod/ oṃ dā da shāṃ ga ni ro dha kā ri ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ ces pas mig dar ser po bcing*/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas me tog gi 'phreng ba byin/ sngar bzhin so shing khyor chu byin rnam par rgyal ba chen po'i chus gtor te/ snying gar sgra gcan la hūm̐/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥ dpral bar zla ba la oṃ/ 'od zer gyis lus dri ma med par byas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dri ba kye bu sdug khyod su yin/ bde chen skal ldan bdag lags so// zhes lan btab/ 'jug yon dang bcas te maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob ma'i snying kar kun rdzob byang chub sems mtshon pa'i zla ba dang*/ don dam byang chub sems mtshon pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal gdab/ oṃ sarba yo ga sogs rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa spyi dang mthun/ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rdo rje 'dzin du bcug la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob pas khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig ces brjod/

oṃ bighā n+ta kri ta hūm̐ zhes pas dgug /āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug /oṃ mahā ra ta su triḍha su to ṣ+ya su su kho badz+ra satwa a d+ya sid+dha māṃ| zhes bskor ba bya/ de nas thal mo sbyar ba shar sgo nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā u pas+thā nā ya at+mā na nīr+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra twa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā karma ṇe āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru ta mā/ phyag bya/ de nas lho phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā me sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ra ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ phyag bya/ de nas nub phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dzā u pa s+thānā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭhi māṃ/ phyag bya/ de nas byang phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzā pra warta nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yāta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra warta ya māṃ/ zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas shar phyogs su/ oṃ gu ru tsa na ṇa u pa s+thā nā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi oṃ sarba satwa pa ri trā ṇā ya āt+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ zhes pas bla ma la phyag bya'o// de nas rdo rje spyi bor gzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ zhes sogs dang*| snying khar gzhag ste dus kyi 'khor lo deng khyod kyi// sogs dang*/ rnam rgyal chen po'i chu sbyin te// 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu sogs/ lha dang*/ yang rdo rje spyi bor gzhag /deng nas brtsams te khyod kyis sogs/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrag pa spyi mthun/ slob dpon khro bo dbab pa'i nas pa dang ldan na slob ma a las 'od dpag med dmar po dmar dkar sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta adhi tiṣ+ṭhan+tu kā la tsakra me ā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas de'i lte bar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi 'khor los mtshan pa la dus me'i steng du hoḥser po snying kar yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i rnam pa g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa la sgra gcan gyi steng du hūm̐ nag po/

mgrin par raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum rin po ches mtshan pa la nyi ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ dpral bar waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes dang thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje rnams spyan drangs rim pa bzhin du sa bon rnams la thim/ de'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis sbar ba'i raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i steng du dzhoḥ de dag gi 'od zer gyis bskyed pas ho la sogs pa'i 'od zer bskyed nas lus kun yongs su gang bar gyur/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug cing rol mor bcas pas/ oṃ a ra ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā be sha ya hūm̐ zhes dbab par bya'o// de nas phebs nas oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥ zhes me tog mgo bo la gzhag pas sangs bar 'gyur ro// mgo bo snying gtsug tor du oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥthebs/ lte mgrin gsang bar hoḥ.āḥk+ṣaḥshes rab kyis bsrung*/ de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor ba ltar bcug la mig sngar ci snang dri/ kha dog gi dbye bas 'phrin las 'grub pa go bar bya/ de nas rdo rje gar dang bcas te rtsa sngags sam yi ge drug pa bzla zhing dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas/ slob dpon gyis/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes sogs kyis bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod/ yi ge gsum gyis lan bdun mngon par sngags pa'i me tog gi slob ma'i snyim pa rnam par dag par byas te lag pa'i pad+ma sbyar ba dag gis dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du rgyal ba lnga'i mtshan ma bkod pa'i maṇ+ḍal la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod pas dor/ me tog gang du lhung ba der gnas pa'i lha khyod kyi rigs kyi lhar 'gyur pa ste/

de'i las kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub bo zhes me tog blangs te slob ma'i mgo bo la/ oṃ pra ti grih+na s+t+wa mi maṃ sa twa mahā ba la zhes pas gdags/ oṃ di byen+d+ri yāṇ+maṅgha ba ya swā hā zhes pas mig dar bkrol/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyed ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlob// 'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun gyi snod du 'gyur| /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par bgyi// de nas rigs kyi lha dang gtso bo dang por byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha bstan par bya'o// 'jug pa'o| /de nas dbang bdun gyi don du slob mas byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag pa g.yon pa nas bskyod de byang skor dbang stegs la gzhag /slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba'i snying ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs kun na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa rnams spyan drangs pa la mchod| slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du/ sangs rgyas rnams la rdor 'chang gis// dbang bskur bzhin du 'gro ba rnams// bsgral phyir yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de dag chags pa chen pos zhu/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi lam nas zhugs nas rdo rje'i lam du byung ba'i khu ba slob ma yang lam de nas zhugs nas lha mo'i pad+ma gnas pa dbang bskur bas skad cig gis sku rdo rje shes rab dang bcas pa'i gzugs ye shes sems dpa' dang tha mi dad pa gyur pa phyir thon nas byang gi dbang stegs su 'dug pa la| spyan ma la sogs pa dbang lha nam mkha'i khams gang bar gnas pas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang na bza' dang sgra dang gar dang glu dang gur kum dang ga bur dang me tog la sogs pa'i char dang*/

byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa dkar po phyag gis gzung nas gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// de ni deng khyod dbang phyug mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes dkon mchog gsum gyi tshigs bcad gsum ka'i tha ma/ de ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog ces sbyar bas dbang bskur/ slar yang spyan ma la sogs pa'i sngags kyi bum pa thams cad nas bsdus pa'i chu rnam rgyal chen por 'khyer nas/ gtsug tor dpung tshigs g.yas g.yon dpyi g.yas g.yon du reg cing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// zhes sogs dang*/ o ā ī rī ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bishodha ni swā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas khams lnga yum lngar gyur cing dbang gi lha rnams de la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ de ni byis pa skyes ma thag ma yis 'khyud pa dang chos mthun/ khams lnga'i dri ma 'khrud/ yum lnga la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang*| yum lnga'i sa bon gzhag /'bras bu sa dang po thob par byed pa chu'i dbang ngo*// yang dbang lha nas cod pan phyag gis gzung nas sngar gyi gnas lngar reg cing oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa ta thā ga ta pa ri shud+dha swā hā zhes pas dbang bskur/ dngos su cod pan mgo bor bskon/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gyur cing dbang gi lha rnams de la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur| de ni byis pa'i gtsug phud gzhag pa dang chos mthun/ phung po lnga'i dri ma 'khrud/ sangs rgyas lnga'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bya ba la dbang*/ sangs rgyas lnga'i sa bon gzhag 'bras bu gnyis pa thob par byed pa cod pan gyi dbang ngo*// de ltar byang phyogs sku'i zhal du dbang gnyis kyi mngal du thog mar khams dang phung po grub pa bzhin lus kyi chos khams dang phung po sbyong bas lus kyi dri ma 'khrud sku rdo rje'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang*/

sku rdo rje'i sa bon gzhag /lus dag pa'i 'bras bu thob bo// de ltar lus dag nas g.yas skor gyis lho sgor gzhag /gsol ba gdab pa nas gsung rdo rje shes rab dang bcas pa'i gzugs ye shes sems dpa' dang tha mi dad par gyur pa phyir 'thon nas lho'i dbang stegs su 'dug pa la/ sna tshogs yum la sogs pa nas| dar dpyangs phyag gis gzung nas gnas lngar reg cing*/ oṃ a ā aṃ a ha haṃ haṃ haḥho phreṃ da sha pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bas dngos su dpral bar bcings| rlung bcu nus ma bcur gyur cing dbang gi lha= /de byis pa'i rna ba 'bugs shing rgyan 'dogs pa dang chos mthun/ rlung bcu'i dri ma 'khrud/ nus ma bcu'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang*| phar phyin bcu'i sa bon 'jig /'bras bu sa gsum pa thob par byed pa dar dpyangs kyi dbang ngo*// gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa nas rdor dril phyag gis gzung nas gnas lngar reg cing*/ oṃ hūm̐ ho sūr+ya tsan+d+ra bi shi dha ka swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur spyi bor gzhag /slar dung chos kyi chu dbang bzhin sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar bya'o// rtsa ro ma gtso bo brkyang ma sna tshogs yum du gyur cing dbang gi= /de ni byis pa rgod pa dang smra bar byed pa dang chos mthun/ rtsa ro rkyang gi dri ma 'khrud/ gtso bo yab yum gyi dngos grub la dbang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nus pa 'jog /nyi zla gcig tu dag cing sa bzhi pa thob par byed pa rdor dril gyi dbang ngo*// de ltar lho phyogs gsung gi zhal du dbang gnyis kyi mngal du rlung dang rtsa grub pa bzhin/ ngag gi chos rlung dang rtsa'i dri ma sbyong bas ngag gi dri ma 'khrud/ gsung rdo rje'i bya ba la dbang*/ de'i nus pa 'jog cing ngag dag pa'i 'bras bu thob bo// de nas g.yas skor gyis shar sgor gzhag nas/

gsol ba gdab pa nas thugs rdo rje shes rab dang nas phyir 'thon shar gyi dbang stegs la 'khod| kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i sems dpa' dang sems ma nas/ rdo rje'i sor gdub phyag gis gzung nas gnas lngar reg cing*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun rang bzhin// sna tshogs yum gyi bdag po'i mchog /oṃ a ā e ai ar ār o au a la ā la bi ṣa ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur bas lag tu byin/ rna ba sogs su me tog bkod/ dbang yul sems dpa' sems mar gyur cing dbang*/ de ni byis pa 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa dang chos mthun/ dbang po dang yul gyi dri ma 'khrud/ sems dpa' sems ma'i dngos grub bsgrub cing rang bzhin shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa la dbang= /rdo rje skye mched kyi sa bon gzhag 'bras bu sa lnga thob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang ngo*// rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa khro bo khro mo/ gdu bu dang rkang gdub bam med na me tog gi 'phreng ba phyag gis gzung nas gnas lngar reg cing*| oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tur brah+ma bi shā ra biṃ shud+dha swā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur bas lag pa dang rkang pa rnams la bcings/ slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam gyi tshul du byas la/ chos gos kyi grwa gzung ba'i khu tshur g.yon pas snying gar gzung zhing g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton te// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir| /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// bdag gi khyod 'dir lung bstan yin// kye che ge mo rdo rje ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya staṃ bhū ra bhu baḥswaḥ me tog lhung ba'i rigs kyi ming bstan cing lung bstan pas/ las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa khro bo khro mor gyur cing dbang= /de ni byis pa'i ming btags pa dang chos mthun/

las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ khro bo khro mo'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang*/ byams sogs tshad med bzhis bdud 'joms pa'i nus pa bzhag /'bras bu sa drug pa thob par byed pa ming gi dbang ngo*// de ltar shar phyogs thugs kyi zhal du dbang gnyis thob pas mngal du dbang po las dbang grub pa bzhin/ dbang po yul la 'jug pa dang las dbang bya ba la 'jug par byed pa'i sems kyi dri ma 'khrud/ thugs rdo rje'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang*/ de'i nus pa 'jog cing yid dag pa'i 'bras bu thob bo// de nas g.yas skor gyis nub sgor khrid dbang stegs la gzhag /ye shes rdo rje shes rab/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum nam mkha'/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan phyag tu gzung nas gnas lngar reg cing*/ oṃ haṃk+ṣaḥdharma tsakra pra warta ka swā hā| dharma'i gnas su badz+ra/ khaṅga/ rat+na/ tsakra/ pad+ma bcug nas lag tu gtad/ ye shes kyi phung po dang rnam shes kyi khams rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur cing dbang*/ slob ma gdan la gnas pa la bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ zhes pas rkang 'og byin/ āḥlas byung ba'i dung oṃ badz+ra bha raṃ gyis lag pa g.yas su gtad/ āḥlas byung ba'i po ti a zhes pa g.yon du gtad/ āḥlas byung ba'i dril bu āḥzhes pas g.yon du gtad de dkrol du bcug /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam sbyor bas// dkon mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// rtag tu de ring nas brtsams te// sems ni bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla na med// kun nas kun tu gang ba yis// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// 'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// sna tshogs ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mtho ba// skyon med dogs dang bral ba yis// da ni sems can don gyis shig

/slob mas phyag byas te| mnga' bdag gsung ba de ltar bgyid// ces pa ni rjes gnang ngo*// bla ma dang lha'i thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng 'byung ste snying kar thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ snying po nye snying rtsa sngags phreng sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nyer bar mdzad du gsol// ces rdo rje dang bcas pa mgo bor gzhag /slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis blang ngo*// 'di ni bgegs kyi bar chad med pa dang*// zhi sogs kyi dngos grub sgrub pa dang*// don dam pa'i sngags kyi dngos grub kyi zhing dag par bya ba sngags kyis so// de nas gser ram dngul las byas pa'i snod nas mar dang sbrang rtsi'i mig sman gser gyi thur mas blangs te/ slob ma'i mig tu praṃ bsam la byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar| /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis sel// sngags kyi nus pa thob nas mi shes pa'i ling tog bsal bas lha'i mig gi mngon shes bskyed pa'i ched do// mig sman gyi'o// a bzlas pa'i me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*| /dus 'khor me long gnas mtshungs pa// dag cing gsal la dri ma med// sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso bo ste// bu khyod snying la yang dag gnas// khyod la 'dren pa'i spyan ldan pas| /ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// 'di ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// lha'i mig thob pa des kyang chos kyi dbyings stong pa sna tshogs gzugs brnyan bzhin du blta zhing shes pas sems can gyi don byed dgos zhes pa'i ched du'o// me long gi'o// de nas hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu hoḥzhes pas byin nas/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rā ga ya swa/ zhes brjod/ slob mas mda' bkang bzhin pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tāṃ a nu rāg ya mi/ zhes brjod cing bgegs la 'bugs par bsam zhing phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu gtad de 'phang ngo*// de 'ang bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi dbyings shin tu phra ba'i 'ben phug cing sangs rgyas pa na yang sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pa'i ched du'o// mda' gzhu'i 'o// de nas slob ma la kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes brjod cing rdor dril gtad la/ rdo rje dril bu rab tu byin nas rab mchog snying rje dag gis dag pa'i chos ni bstan par bya// nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor 'phrog bya mchog gi pad+ma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni brten par bya// gdol pa mo sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi pad+mar smad mi bya// sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bsrung mi bya// rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs// zhes drang ba dang nges pa'i don gyis phyi dang nang gi dam tshig gi rnam par dag pa dang*/ chu ni sgrol ma la sogs lha mo cod pan zhes pa rgyal ba dpa' bo'i dar dbyangs nus ma rnams// rdo rje dril bu nyi zla dag dang brtul zhugs dag kyang yul te ming ni byams sogs sbyor ba'o// rjes gnang rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal mo srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo rjes su rig pa ste// sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog pa'i dbang bskur bdun po 'di dag dkyil 'khor du ni yang dag rab sbyin bya// zhes dbang gi rnam par dag pa'o| /de dag 'dogs so// de ltar nub phyogs ye shes kyi zhal du rjes gnang 'dogs dang bcas pa'i dbang ni/

byis pa la pha yis klog la sogs pa byed pa dang chos mthun/ byis pa skyes ma thag pa ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba bzhin/ ye shes kyi dri ma 'khrud/ ye shes rdo rje'i bya ba la dbang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing gzhan la phan par byed la mi 'pho ba'i bde ba rjes su rig pa ste stong pa nyid stong pa'i nus pa bzhag /'bras bu sa bdun pa thob par byed do// de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bdun thob/ bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*| 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi nus pa 'jog /bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i spyod pa dang grol ba ster bar byed| gsang sngags kyi dge bsnyen du gyur to// de nas dbang gi rgan gzhon shes par bya ba'i dus go bar bya ba ni/ 'dir lo che ge mo dang*/ rigs ldan gyi rgyal po che ge mo chos ston pa dang*| skar ma dang*/ sbyor ba/ byed pa che ge mo la/ rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo bdag gi slob ma che ge mo khyed rnams mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bdun bskur te 'og min gyi mthar thug pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa nyid kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du bdag gis lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ngo*// zhes brjod do// dbang bdun gyi cho ga ste/ de tsam gyis tshim pa'i slob ma ni yon blang zhing mjug chog rnams bsgrub bo// da ni sems can gzhug pa dang*/ lam yongs su shes pa dang*/ rgyud mnyam pa la dbang ba'i ched du gong ma chung ngu bskur te rim pa 'dis so// ras kyi yol ba la sogs pas dben par byas pa'i gnas su gzugs dang lang tsho dang ldan pa lo bcu gcig pa nas nyi shu'i bar ram/ de med na gzhan phyag rgya ma dbang gis smin pa zhig dang maṇ+ḍal bla ma la phul te/

sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs// ye shes sku khyod la 'dud do// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang*// dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod// bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa// bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs// ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar// bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas slob ma la mig dar bcings/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ slob ma sku rdo rje dang*| rig ma tha mal gyi rang bzhin dag pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha mo gzugs kyi sgeg pa dang chags pa'i blta bas nu ma la reg du gzhug go /de ni lag pas 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bas phyi rol yul sna tshogs pa dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags pa 'gags nas dga' ba'i bde bar rang rig pa ni/ dpal ldan shes rab nu ma la yang dang por reg pa gang yin bum pa'i dbang ni de nyid do// zhes pa'am rgod pas dga' ba thob pa yon tan gnyis kyi bdag nyid dag pa ste/ rgod pas dga' ba thob pa ni// rgod pa dag la slob dpon nyid// ces de ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /bsnyen pa'i yan lag nyan shes bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon bzhag /'bras bu sa brgyad pa thob par byed/ gsang sngags kyi dge tshul du gyur pa yin no// bum dbang ngo*// de nas sngar bzhin maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan zhing slob mas phul ba'i phyag rgya ma stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs yum du bskyed/ rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlabs te snyoms par zhugs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snying ka'i sa bon gyis spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa rnams gtsug tor nas zhugs bde ba chen por zhu ba a ba dhū tī nas song ste rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba brten par byas pad+ma nas phyung ste mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs nas/

sngon gyi sangs rgyas sras rnams la// rdo rje 'dzin pas dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni yid 'ong bas// de ltar bu rnams dbang bskur ro// sngar bzhin nga rgyal gyis sngags brjod/ slob mas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad tshogs pa'i blos/ kye bde ba chen po zhes brjod cing 'thung ngo*// shes rab kyis kyang gos dang bral bas thig le chu skyes na gnas pa de'i khar sbyin gdong g.yogs dkrol phyag rgya'i bha ga la bltas pas 'dod chags cher g.yos te rtog pa phra bas phal cher 'gags rdzas dang gnas gsang ba las/ mchog dga'i ye shes rang rig pas sam/ bltas pas dga' ba thob pa yon tan gsum gyi bdag nyid dag pa/ gsang bdag las ri bong 'dzin pa myang ba dang ni lta ba dag gis gsang ba'i dbang du 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ blta ba dga' ba thob pa ni// lta ba gsang ba de bzhin no// de ltar gsang ba'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /lam nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag bsgom pa la dbang*// gsung rdo rje longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /'bras bu sa dgu pa thob par byed/ gsang sngags kyi dge slong du gyur to// gsang dbang ngo*// de nas slob mas sngar bzhin maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab| mig dar bla mas/ ji ltar skal ba ngan pa'i sems can 'di ni sgom pa sogs la 'di dbang ba dang*/ rgyud mnyan pa'i slad du ste sems can rnams la rgyud bstan pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i slad du ni ma yin no zhes bsams nas/ 'di ni khyed rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes rgyal ba dpang du byas shing*/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis gnang*// 'khor lo'i rim pa'i rab sbyor gyis// bde ba dam pa myang bar byos// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du gnas pa blta// zhes brjod cing gtad/

des kyang lus dri zhim po byugs gcer bu byas nas chu skyes slob ma la ston cing*/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// bdag ni de yi mdun gnas so// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes byed sogs// ji ltar bya ba pad+mar bgyi// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid la ni rtag tu gnas// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas slob ma thugs rdo rje dang*/ rig ma de'i lha mor bskyed/ gnas drug tu rigs drug gi sa bon bkod| rdo rje pad+ma byin gyis brlab/ reg pa dang tsum+ba na la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par 'jug /oṃ shī shī shī ha ha ha swā hā/ sngar bzhin nga rgyal gyis sngags brjod/ 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis lus byin gyis brlabs shing bla mas kyang yab yum dpag med spyan drangs ro gcig tu de la bstim/ man ngag las dga' ba bzhi'i dbye ba shes par bya nus pa ji lta bar gzung la dal bus btang ste chu skyes nas blang la btung ngo*// des rtog pa mtha' dag 'gags/ dbang po gnyis la skyes pa'i 'gyur ba'i bde ba khyad par dga' ba'i ye shes rang rig pa'am/ lag bcangs las dga' ba thob pa yon tan bzhi'i bdag nyid kyang*/ lag bcangs dga' ba thob pa ni// lag bcangs dag la shes rab nyid// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pa thob/ gnyid 'thug gi dri ma dag /lam bsgrub pa'i yan lag la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku'i sa bon bzhag /sa bcu pa thob| gsang sngags kyi gnas brtan rgan por gyur pa yin no// dbang gsum pa'o// de nas maṇ+ḍal gsol btab byas nas/ slob ma ye shes rdo rjer bskyed la/ nor bu'i nang du chud pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba rtogs pa bzhi pa'o zhes gsungs pas dbang gsum pa'i dus su khyad par gyi dga' ba nyams su myong ba'i mthar thig le 'dzag pa gsum gyi rjes su byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtser rgyas te phyir ma zags pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bde ba chen po ni dbang bzhi pa yin la/

de nyid gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa las bde ba thob pa yon tan lnga dag pa ste/ gnyis gnyis phrad pas bde thob pa// gnyis gnyis 'khyud pas de bzhin nyid// de ltar dbang ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes so// de ltar byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ bzhi pa'i dri ma dag /lam bsgrub pa chen po la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i sa bon bzhag /'bras bu sa bcu gnyis pa thob bo// 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dbang ngo*// da ni rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i gnas sbyin pa dang ston pa po byed pa'i gong ma chen po'i 'am/ gong ma'i yang gong ma'i dbang brjod par bya ste/ dbang gong ma'i don du phyag rgya bcu phul/ slob dpon gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du mnyam pa'i sa'i char dge slong la khru bzhi pa la rab lnga'i re khā byas nas/ de'i dbus su shing stan gyi steng du khru gnyis pa'i pad 'dab brgyad la dge slong*/ dge tshul la khru gnyis pa'i pad 'dab re khā med pa/ khyim pa la ba lcis byugs pa khru gsum pa shing stan yang med pa phal pa'i stan la rim pa bzhin bkod pa/ snga ma la bu mo bu ma skyes pa mdzes ma brgyad dang*/ gzhon nu ma gnyis kyis bum pa brgyad pa dang rnam rgyal gnyis thegs la sngar bzhin dbang bskur ba'i khrus byas/ gnyis pa bu mo bzhi dang gzhon nu ma gnyis/ bum pa bzhi dang rnam rgyal/ tha mal bu mo gcig dang*/ gzhon nu ma gcig /bum pa gcig dang rnam rgyal gyis so// de nas/ kye bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad thob bo// da ni bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ zhes zhu zhing slob dpon gyis lan phyag rgya bcu'i nang nas rang gi chung ma 'di gzung nas de dang lhan cig tu bdag la gsol ba gdab pa thob cig /ces bka' stsal sbyin to// de nas khyim pas rang gi chung ma dang*/ rab byung gis gtum mo dang lhan cig gser gyi maṇ+ḍal byas nas gong chung ltar gsol ba btab/

dbang bskur ba la khyim pa la chung ma/ rab byung la g.yung mo sgra rdo rje mar bskyed pa/ rgyan thams cad bkrol zhing gcer bu byas nas sngar ltar reg cing 'khyud du bcug /de nas shar du lo bcu gnyis la sgrol ma/ lhor bcu gnyis ma gos dkar mo/ byang du bcu gsum ma mā ma kī/ nub tu bcu bzhi ma spyan ma| mer bcu drug ma reg bya rdo rje ma/ srin por bcu bdun ma ro rdo rje ma/ dbang ldan du bco brgyad ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ rlung du bcu dgu ma dri rdo rje ma ste rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag na gri gug dang thod pa can bkod pa rim pa bzhin gtad ste nu ma la reg du bcug /de ni bum pa'i dbang la bla ma las slob ma chung ma'o zhes gsungs pa/ dbang bskur bas bla ma las slob ma chung ma ste/ gsang dbang gi snod du rung zhig gsang sngags kyi kun spyod la mi dad pa mi skye ba'i dag pa bya'o// gsang dbang la zla mtshan dang ldan pa la bla mas spyod pa tsam dang*/ dbang gsum pa la dge slong bcu/ dge tshul drug /khyim pa la rang gi chung ma gcig pu gtad de mtshan mo phyed nas chu tshod gnyis na skya rengs 'char ba de tsam du snyoms pa 'jug tu bcug cing byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa med par sdom pa tsam las chog gzhan slob ma gzhug pa'i dbang gsum ji lta ba'o// de nas tshogs dkyil bsdus bla mas slob mar khyad par dga' ba'i mthar lhan cig skyes pa'i skad cig bdag gis brjod pa gang yin pa de dang*/ thig le gsum gyis mthar gang yin pa de ni don dam par mi 'gyur te/ de ni kun rdzob dang po'i don gyi dbang yin no// don dam par ni rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba 'pho ba med pa'o// des na bde ba chen po 'di ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o// de bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang*// bde ba chen po byang chub sems// brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya// bha gar liṅga rab gzhag nas// byang chub sems ni spro mi bya// khams gsum po ni ma lus pa// sangs rgyas gzugs su spro bar bya// bsrung ba 'di nyid kho na yis// skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid| /tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs// bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan// pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug

/'di ni rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyis// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// rang dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i slad// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes nas// 'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin// skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni/ gal te khyod bsrung bdag gi bu// de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob 'gyur// ci ste chags pas zil mnan bdag /gtso bo'i mdun du blangs nas ni// sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na// de tshe ngu 'bod du 'gro 'gyur// dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su// gang tshe byang chub sems lhung 'gyur| de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni// pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blang*// zhes bshad nas/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i slad du dbang bskur ba ni/ kye dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin las da ni bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i lam thams cad shes so// zhes zhus nas/ dus 'di nas brtsams te/ khyod dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spangs nas bla ma gzhan bsten par mi bgyi'o// zhes dam bcas pa'i slob ma sngar bzhin gdan dang khrus/ dge slong la cod pan/ dge tshul la dar dpyangs/ khyim pa la rdo rje'i sor gdub bcing*/ gdug pa sdigs par byed pa'i mchog /gang gis ngur smig mthong ba yis// lha min sa yi 'og tu 'gro// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya// de nas sku gsung thugs rdo rjer byed pa'i slad du rdo rje'i sku'i phyag rgya ste/ de nas rdo rje mchod phyir thogs gser gyi rang bzhin nam skud pa'i bdag nyid tshangs par byed pa'i slad du dbyangs sum cu brjod pas byin no| /nags rin dar dpyangs gsung*/ gtsug rgyan thugs zhes pa ltar ram/ bu ston/ me tog gang la phog pa'i phyag mtshan de nyid kyis sngags brjod de byin pa dbang phyug chen po byed pa'i slad du'o// phyag rgya drug 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa sogs kyis dang*/

cod pan dang dar dpyangs/ gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can sogs kyi sh+lo ka gcig gis byin pa khyab 'jug chen po byed pa'i slad du'o// de nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i nga rgyal gzung nas/ tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje 'dzin// gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che// rgyal po thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// de yang khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che// zhes brjod pas so// de nas sngar bzhin lung bstan pa dang*/ shar gyi sgo ru slob ma'i steng du gdugs gzung la g.yas su skor ba byed bzhin pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgor gdugs dang bcas pas mchod pa la/ slob ma 'di ni khyed la gtad// rgyud ni 'dzin pa po ru mdzod// ces dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la gsol ba btab/ gdugs gzhan du gzhag nas| da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyang ni bzhed pa yin// sems can rnams la brtse don du// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du gyis// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yi// srid pa kun las nges grol ba// khyed rnams de ring legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod ldog pa yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te// khams gsum rgyal srid chen po yi// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyi nam yang ma byed cig /'dod pa kun la nyer spyod pas| /gang la'ang 'jigs med rol ba nyid// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ba// 'di las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung*// srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med de bzhin yongs mi spang*// slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste// dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin// mi 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin// gzhan yang cho ga ji lta ba bzhin dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis rtag tu dgongs shing byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/

dri med 'od las/ de ltar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad la dbang bskur bar 'gyur zhing rgyud thams cad kyi ston pa po dang*/ sngags thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba po dang*/ dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub pa po de dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud ston pa po rdo rje slob dpon ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ji lta ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang po'i sangs rgyas ji lta ba de bzhin du thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis blta bar bya'o// zhes pas dbugs dbyung*/ de nas slob ma dga' bas/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bu yod// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su deng bdag 'gyur// zhes brjod/ mig thur dang*| me long dang*/ chos bshad pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi 'phrin las dang*/ slob dpon gyi las rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba sngar bzhin bya'o// de nas yon phul tshogs rnams oṃ badz+ra kro dha shwa ri sarba dra bya ṇī bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi 'thor bas bsangs gtor byas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs/ de ltar srin lag gis blangs nas gru gsum pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal zlum por byas la ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs na maḥmachod pa la sogs pa'i sngags tshig gis dbul lo// sdig bshags sogs byas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab ste gshegs su gsol/ de nas gtor ma btang ngo*// oṃ hā ritī paṇ+ḍi ka pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ dū tī kī a gra gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes 'phrog ma dang pho nya dag la chang bu dang*/ phud yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags pa sa la gzhag pas sbyin no// de nas yon bdag gis maṇ+ḍal phul la ci bde bar gsol bar zhu zhes brjod cing*/ las kyi rdo rje gus par slob dpon la pad+ma'i phyag gi bdud rtsi/

gzigs shig mdzes pa sogs kyis drangs/ nges kyang pad+ma'i lag kor sngon du 'gro ba'i ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ bde gshegs chos la sogs kyi blangs shing*/ slob dpon la thams cad nyis 'gyur/ thams cad kyis legs par zos nas rdo rje'i glu gar mthar me thun rang rigs dang lhan cig spyod par bya'o| /de nas lhag ma bsdus la yi ge gsum gyis bsngags shing kha phru btab nas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa swā hā/ lhag ma'i gtor ma mar me dang bcas phyir gtong du gzhug go /de nas bsod nams bsngo ba byas te snying rjes sems can thams cad la dbang bskur dkyil 'khor ba mchod/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas bdag bskyed bzhin du ye shes pa bsdus| bum pa'i gos zung bsrung ba'i gzhon nu ma la byin/ kha rgyan nam rang gi lag pas sam rdo rjes tshangs pa'i thig gi lam nas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'i bar du gshegs/ rdul tshon cung zad spyi bor bkod/ lhag ma 'phyag sa bum par blug chu bo chen por dor/ bum pa chus bkang dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'ongs te gtor ba lang gi lci ba la sogs pas kyang byug go /bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dus 'khor zhabs chung ba'i yid 'ong 'phreng ba'i chings la/ sa dhū pu tra'i dkyil 'khor tshogs brgyan cing*/ dri med 'od dang*/ rje btsun nā ro'i 'grel pa dang mthun par dngos grub 'byung ba'i khungs 'di pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba yin no// 'dis dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud dar rgyas su gyur cig /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bshad zin la/ ral gri'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje khu tshur bcings te gung mo dang mdzub mo bsgreng*/ rin po che'i phyag rgya ni sor mo lnga sbyar te gung mo dbus nas steng du cung zad phyung ba| 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ni/ sor mo rnams 'khor lo'i rtsibs ltar rnam par brkyang ba/

pad+ma'i phyag rgya ni mthe bong dang mthe'u chung sbyar lhag ma rnams brkyang ba/ gri gug khu tshur bcas mthe'u chung bsgreng ba/ khyi'i phyag rgya khu tshur bcas mthe'u chung sbrel bzhin pas bskor ba/ stang stabs las g.yas brkyang ni/ rkang pa g.yon bskum ste g.yas pa de las mtho lnga ru brkyang ba drang por gnas pa/ de las bzlog pa g.yon brkyang*/ rkang pa gnyis kyi sor mo rnams mnyam par gnas pa mnyam pa'i 'dug stangs/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar la sor mo nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pas pus mo ya gcig gyen du cung zad bkan par rol pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi bar la sor nyer bzhi ldan pas pus mo gnyis rgyab tu cung zad bkan pas sa ga'o// de la ngang pa'i gshog pa ltar byas te bar la khru do pa zlum po/ kaṇ+ḍa pa zhes pa gar stabs so// //
